name: 大唐西域记
name_en: The Great Tang Records on the Western Regions
era: Tang dynasty, Zhenguan era (7th century CE)
description_zh: 一部架空角色参与的历史旅行冒险，以玄奘西行所经的丝路与印度诸国为地理背景。玩家扮演原创旅人、译者、商队成员或僧侣，在真实历史人物与行程周边展开原创支线；不改写玄奘本人所记史实，也不把现代虚构情节冒充原典。
description_en: A historical travel adventure for an original character among the Silk Road and South Asian regions described in Xuanzang’s seventh-century account. Play as a traveler, interpreter, caravan member, or monk alongside the documented journey; side stories are original and never presented as source text or as altering the record.

main_questline.main_objective: Carry a personal mission across the connected regions of the Silk Road and South Asia while helping the traveling party navigate language, logistics, hospitality, and changing local conditions.
current_major_tasks: Choose a credible role and reason to join or intersect with the documented journey.
Navigate caravan logistics, interpreters, local customs, and safe passage without flattening distinct cultures.
Help resolve original local dilemmas involving travelers, monasteries, markets, and route safety.
Keep the route geographically coherent and respect the historical chronology of the account.
Bring the character’s mission to a fitting conclusion without claiming that the player changed the recorded journey.
major_story_threads: Departure from Chang’an and the northern Silk Road oasis route
Crossing Central Asia and the Hindu Kush into Gandhara
Travel through North India and the Ganges regions
Buddhist pilgrimage sites and study at Nalanda
Eastern, southern, and western Indian regions and Sri Lanka
The return route through the Pamirs to Khotan

key_figures.drive: seek Buddhist learning and bring texts back to China

key_figures.role: original supporting characters, varying by region
key_figures.drive: protect their communities and negotiate exchange

relationship_webs.tension: hospitality and mutual understanding under language barriers
doctrinal debate, translation, and limited resources
personal stakes must fit around documented events rather than overwrite them

mainline_stages: Chang’an: prepare a credible personal mission and join a westbound party
Silk Road: cross oasis corridors through trade, translation, and route choices
Central Asia: navigate mountain passes and regional courts
India: follow a historically coherent route among cities, monasteries, and pilgrimage sites
Nalanda and southern routes: study, debate, and continue the itinerary
Return: retrace the route toward Khotan and reflect on what the character learned

route_continuity.name: 路线连续性
route_continuity.description: 旅行推进遵循可查证的古代地理顺序。
route_continuity.player_impact: 支线不可瞬移或跳过必要距离；长途行程可通过季节、补给与停留推进。

language_and_interpretation.name: 语言与翻译
language_and_interpretation.description: 不同区域有自己的语言、习俗与知识传统。
language_and_interpretation.player_impact: 使用译者、礼节和核实，误解会带来可信后果而非把文化差异当笑料。

source_boundary.name: 史料边界
source_boundary.description: 基本旅程以《大唐西域记》记载为路线参照。
source_boundary.player_impact: 玩家支线是明确的原创虚构；不得伪称玄奘原文或改写真实记载。

travel_log.name: 行程札记
travel_log.description: 以非秘密的游戏札记记录里程、停留、线索和当地联系人。
travel_log.player_impact: 回归时可快速复盘，不保存现实用户敏感数据。

art_style: Tang-era travelogue illustration with silk-road mural and manuscript aesthetics

art_direction.visual_style: historically grounded 7th-century Silk Road and South Asian travel illustration; regionally specific architecture, textiles, landscapes, and transport; subtle Dunhuang mural and manuscript-painting influence without mixing unrelated periods
art_direction.color_palette: mineral indigo, ochre, cinnabar, muted jade, parchment ivory, restrained gold
art_direction.character_portraits: period-grounded Tang and regional clothing, respectful and non-stereotyped faces, no modern costume or celebrity likeness
art_direction.battle_scenes: avoid spectacle by default; emphasize travel, negotiation, landscape, learning, and historically plausible hazards
reference: public-domain historical maps and archaeological site references
Great Tang Records on the Western Regions route and place-name structure

content_guidance.source_basis: Use the public-domain classical Chinese text of the Great Tang Records on the Western Regions for route and place context. The player’s plots and dialogue are original transformative fiction; do not imply they are part of Xuanzang’s record.
content_guidance.canon_policy: Keep the 12-fascicle itinerary geographically and chronologically plausible; distinguish recorded description from invented side stories.
content_guidance.cultural_policy: Avoid treating diverse peoples and Buddhist traditions as interchangeable; identify regional setting where possible and do not invent facts as historical certainties.
content_guidance.agency_policy: The player is an original traveler whose side mission intersects the route without replacing Xuanzang or changing the recorded expedition.

world_source_notes.route_summary: Chang’an → northern Silk Road → Central Asia → India and Sri Lanka → Pamir return → Khotan
world_source_notes.gameplay_rule: Use the source text for geography and documented customs; label invented player-facing scenes as creative fiction rather than quotation or historical fact.
